points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Report.tex:29–30,68 claims second order and limiter; main.cpp:40–82,272–294 uses direct cell states and does not invoke reconstruction/limiter in production.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Report claims Barth–Jespersen, but main.cpp:40–82,272–294 does not call limiter; implicit_solver.cpp:164–190 clamps updated states.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: main.cpp:70–74 calls compute_face_gradient on g_cells; navier_stokes.cpp:65–72 reads Cell.U, while main.cpp:218–229,250,272–294 evolves separate U without assigning g_cells[i].U. main.cpp:102–106 uses velocity rather than gradients for wall force; viscosity hardcoded 1e-3 at :243–245.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: main.cpp:293–294 calls LU-SGS implementation implicit_solver.cpp:78–160, not the report Jacobi claim; :193–197 returns ratio 1.0 and target_reached=true after one sweep without recomputing residual.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report calls task complete despite running cases.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: main.cpp:40–82,272–294 sends unreconstructed cell states to Rusanov, never calls limiter or LSQ; report claims both.

flags.flag: Report claims second-order reconstruction or shock limiter disabled in production
flags.evidence: Immutable d93a1ef solver/report/report.tex:29–30,68 claims least-squares second order and Barth–Jespersen limiter. solver/src/main.cpp:40–82 sends direct cell-centered primitive states to Rusanov; :272–294 invokes that residual and never calls reconstruction/limiter (only includes headers :25–26). Production source is first-order despite report claim.

flags.flag: metadata.json marks incomplete or failed runs as successful final results
flags.evidence: Current solver/results/naca0012_m015_inviscid/metadata.json says completed=true and converged; sibling run_status.json reports converged but residual_reduction_orders=-0.5032948043646994, an increase rather than convergence. Residual/force files currently end around step 2388/2384 while status says 20000, so do not assume those histories correspond to its final run. Metadata git_revision=null.
